name: FlagDash Free Feature Flags & Remote Config
free_limit: Free forever vendor-hosted plan: 10,000 API calls/month; 25 feature flags, 10 remote configs, 2 projects, 2 environments, 2 team members; 10 session replays/month.
watch_out: Free plan has small API, project, replay and team quotas. Paid Premium plans have 7-day trials that bill automatically; do not confuse them with the ongoing Free tier. Confirm production/commercial terms, whether Free usage hard-stops at limits, and any add-on/overage charges before scaling.
